title: DSGE-Teddy - Go Hard
htmlContent:
DSGE-Teddy has released a brand new single "Go Hard," an amazing body of work that shows the artistry that music can compose. It’s amazing music with an authentic touch to it that resonates with the soul, with something for music lovers everywhere, to get the more we all love to hear in new music we discover and add to our life.

The level of musical genius given in this record, is beyond any description words can give, with a sound that leaves you speechless. The production brings an amazing sound with a classic feel packed with soul, that takes you back to music having a happy feeling to it. The writing shines and the vocals even more, as it all works in perfect harmony to make something impossible not to enjoy.
